unit.description: One exact contiguous quotation in the focus source, copied without rewriting.

kind.description: Semantic kind; must agree with modality and relationship role.

summary.description: Complete meaning of this unit, preserving governing scope, qualifications and modal force.

actor.description: Source-supported responsible person or entity; empty if unstated.

action.description: Source-supported action; empty when inapplicable or unstated.

object.description: What the action concerns; preserve option grouping; empty if unstated.

actor_quote.description: Exact source support for actor, including antecedent if needed.

logic_text.description: Verbatim source wording retaining AND/OR, thresholds, units, dates and negation; no invented executable logic.

relation.description: A condition/exception's relationship to its baseline; none for other kinds.

modality.description: Normative force: must, should, permission may, prohibition must_not, exemption not_required, descriptive possible, not_stated or uncertain.

modality_quote.description: Exact support for modal force; preserve generally, might, should and negation.

scope_text.description: ALL source-supported conditions governing this unit, including inherited parent cases and timing; do not transfer neighboring branch scope.

choice_text.description: Complete source choice/grouping in words, including nested AND/OR and qualifications.

jurisdiction.description: Territorial scope only when explicitly supported in supplied text; never infer from URL.

jurisdiction_quote.description: Exact source support for jurisdiction; empty when unstated.

applies_to.description: Exact main-rule quotations targeted by this condition or exception; never summaries or invented remote text.

references.description: Source section labels for cross-references, including unresolved remote targets.

scope_quotes.description: Exact source passages defining the governing conditions, including parent lead-ins outside the main quote.

context_quotes.description: Exact explanatory passages that aid interpretation without asserting conditions.

alternative_quotes.description: EVERY exact source option with its qualifying text, not just the list introduction.
